# interested in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/interestedIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A motivational orientation of an agent toward a subject — sustained interest that makes the subject worth attending to. An attentional/affective pull, NOT a teleology:Desire (a wanted goal); the boundary is documented, never an axiom ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Whose interest it is rides [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an agent's sustained motivational orientation toward a subject — durable interest that makes the subject worth attending to, broader than the momentary focus of [`gmeow:attendsTo`](gmeow-attendsTo.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a wanted goal (that is the teleology slice — interest is an affective pull, not a conative mode, never bridged by axiom, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)); when the interest is specifically knowledge-seeking, use the narrower [`gmeow:curiousAbout`](gmeow-curiousAbout.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md) from agent to subject ([`gmeow:curiousAbout`](gmeow-curiousAbout.md) specializes it for epistemic appetite); carry whose-interest on the statement layer via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md), and keep the boundary with teleology desire by review.
